# Negative Framing 独立审查

Director 转发 Agent 调 red-section 产出的"Framing 调整提案"给你独立审查。你的职责是防止 Agent **rationalize**（把所有 negative 结果都包装成"重要发现"）。

## 四维度审查（任一不过关即 critical）

### 1. Rationalization 检测
- 原 hypothesis 是否被偷换?（检查 ROADMAP / idea.yaml 的原始 claim vs 新 framing 的 claim）
- 是否把"method 不 work"硬说成"我们发现了 method 的 limitation"?
- 新 framing 的贡献声明在现有实验数据下真的成立,还是只换了说法掩盖弱结果?

### 2. Evidence 对齐
- 新 framing 的每个 claim 是否有 registry 中的实验证据?
- 有没有现有实验**反驳**新 framing 而被忽略?
- 新 framing 需要的 ablation / 补实验是否已经识别出来?

### 3. Narrative 连贯性
- abstract / intro / contribution / experiments / conclusion 在新 framing 下是否自洽?
- 有没有遗留旧 framing 的 claim 尚未清理?

### 4. 诚实度
- limitations section 是否承认了这次调整的代价?
- related work 定位是否需要重写（新 framing 可能对标不同的 SOTA）?

## 输出

`reviewer_post_to_director` 附具体证据段落。
- critical → 提案必须重做,Agent 不得直接改 paper
- warning → 允许进入下一步,但必须修正指出的问题
- info → 通过

# trace-verdict-study — 论文写作计划
# 生成日期: 2026-05-15
# 投稿目标: EMNLP 2026 Main (ARR May 25, 2026)

submission:
  venue: "EMNLP 2026 Main (ARR)"
  deadline: "2026-05-25"
  format: "8 pages + unlimited references + unlimited appendix"
  fallback: "EMNLP 2026 Findings"
  paper_type: "Empirical study"
  title_candidates:
    - "Exception Is All You Need: Fault Detection as a Universal Mechanism for Verdict Prediction"
    - "What Makes Traces Work for Verdict Prediction? An Empirical Study of Diagnostic Signal Sufficiency"
    - "Beyond Trace Reasoning: Exception Events as Model-Agnostic Signals for Verdict Prediction"

# ============================================================
# 论文 Outline
# ============================================================
outline:

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Section 1: Introduction (~1.2 pages)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  - section: "1. Introduction"
    status: write_now  # 不依赖 pending 结果，核心 framing 已定
    estimated_length: "1.2 pages"
    key_points:
      - "Trace SFT 在代码生成任务上效果不一致 (DCSH, TracePile)，verdict prediction 场景未被探索"
      - "提出核心问题: verdict prediction 的 minimal sufficient diagnostic signal 是什么？"
      - "Reframe verdict prediction 为 fault detection task"
      - "Headline result: exception_only 跨模型 99.83%/99.33% (gap=0.50pp), VOTA gap=14.96pp"
      - "三个 contributions 对应三个 claims"
    contributions:
      - "首次系统研究 execution trace SFT 在 verdict prediction (binary pass/fail) 上的效果"
      - "发现 exception event 是 model-agnostic diagnostic signal，跨模型 gap=0.50pp"
      - "通过 component ablation 和 loss ablation 揭示 information density (74%) 而非 gradient dilution (26%) 是 trace compression 的主要驱动力"
    supporting_experiments: []  # 综合引用全部实验
    writing_notes: "开头用 DCSH 'no single trace consistently outperforms' 作为 motivation; 第二段引 TracePile scaling 但 generation-only; 第三段提出 fault detection reframing; 第四段 headline numbers; 第五段 contributions list"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Section 2: Related Work (~1.0 page)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  - section: "2. Related Work"
    status: write_now
    estimated_length: "1.0 page"
    subsections:
      - name: "2.1 Execution Trace SFT for Code LLMs"
        key_refs:
          - "DCSH (Wang et al., EMNLP Findings 2025) — 5 trace formats, generation tasks, inconsistent"
          - "TracePile (Chen et al., NeurIPS 2025) — 2.6M samples, generation only"
          - "NExT (Ni et al., ICML 2024) — self-training on trace CoT"
          - "ET-CoT (Eguchi & Akiba, ICML 2025 Workshop) — sub-line trace for Qwen"
          - "TRACED (Ding et al., ICSE 2024) — encoder-based execution-aware pretraining"
        positioning: "先前工作全部评估生成任务 (code generation/repair); 无人测试 verdict classification; 无人做 component ablation"
      - name: "2.2 Code Verdict Prediction"
        key_refs:
          - "APPT (TSE 2024) — BERT+LSTM patch correctness, 79.7%"
          - "LLM4PatchCorrect (TSE 2024) — zero-shot with trace input, 84.4%"
          - "APSG (Yang et al., 2025) — Graph-LoRA patch correctness"
          - "Calibration (Spiess et al., ICSE 2025) — code LLM calibration"
        positioning: "patch correctness ≠ verdict prediction (不同输入空间); 无人用 SFT + trace signal 做 verdict"
      - name: "2.3 Trace Compression and Selective Execution Analysis"
        key_refs:
          - "TraceCoder (Huang et al., ICSE 2026) — diagnostic probes vs full trace"
          - "InspectCoder (Wang et al., 2025) — LLM-controlled debugger"
          - "Haque et al. (ACL 2025 Workshop) — raw trace 帮助有限, LLM-optimized format 更好"
        positioning: "selective trace 是趋势但用于 repair; 我们首次量化 component-level 贡献对 verdict 的影响"
    writing_notes: "每个 subsection ~0.33 page; 每篇 1-2 句; 最后一句 bridge 到本文 gap"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Section 3: Method (~1.5 pages)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  - section: "3. Experimental Setup"
    status: write_now
    estimated_length: "1.5 pages"
    subsections:
      - name: "3.1 Task Definition"
        content: "Verdict prediction: given (code, input, expected_output, [trace]), predict pass/fail"
        key_points:
          - "Binary classification via SFT (instruction-tuned format)"
          - "不同于 code generation — 输出空间是 {pass, fail}"
      - name: "3.2 Dataset"
        content: "CRUXEval (Gu et al., ICML 2024) — 800 functions, 我们的 split: 4720 train / 1190 test"
        key_points:
          - "数据集来源: CRUXEval (Wang et al. 即 DCSH 构建的 verdict 版本)"
          - "Trace 生成: Python tracer 提取 full execution trace"
          - "Pass/fail 比例说明"
        writing_notes: "注意引用链: CRUXEval 原始 benchmark (Gu et al., 2024), verdict 数据构建方法 (Wang et al., 2025)"
      - name: "3.3 VOTA Trace Representation"
        content: "Variable-Outcome Trace Abstraction 的三个组件"
        key_points:
          - "Exception summary: [ERROR] type + message"
          - "Assertion-point (actual/expected): 关键检查点的值快照"
          - "Loop compression: 循环行为模式摘要"
          - "对比 full trace: VOTA 是 targeted extraction 而非 lossy compression"
      - name: "3.4 Experimental Conditions"
        content: "7 conditions 表格 + 2 models"
        key_points:
          - "Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B: 全部 7 conditions (no_trace, full_trace, VOTA, exception_only, ae_only, loop_only, label_only_loss)"
          - "DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B: 4 conditions (exception_only, VOTA, no_trace, full_trace)"
          - "训练细节: LoRA, epochs, lr, seed"
          - "Evaluation: accuracy, ECE, Brier score"
    supporting_experiments:
      - "所有实验 IDs"
    writing_notes: "用表格列出 conditions 和 models; VOTA 组件描述要配 example (Figure 1)"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Section 4: Results (~2.5 pages) — 核心
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  - section: "4. Results"
    status: partial  # 核心数据已有, DeepSeek full_trace pending
    estimated_length: "2.5 pages"
    subsections:
      - name: "4.1 Traces Help, Compression Helps More"
        status: ready
        claim: 2
        key_points:
          - "no_trace 75.1% → full_trace 81.8% → VOTA 99.41% (Qwen)"
          - "Label-only loss ablation: full_trace 86.2% (+4.5pp), gradient dilution = 26%"
          - "Information overload = 74% (13pp gap 无法被 loss masking 消除)"
        supporting_experiments:
          - "full_trace_seed42_v5: 81.8%"
          - "vota_seed42_v5: 99.41%"
          - "full_trace_label_only_seed42: 86.2%"
        figures: [fig_2]
        tables: [tab_1]

      - name: "4.2 Exception Signal Transfer"
        status: ready
        claim: 1
        key_points:
          - "Component ablation: exception_only 99.83% ≥ VOTA 99.41% (p=0.01)"
          - "Cross-model: Qwen 99.83% ± 0.00 (3 seeds); DeepSeek 2/3 seeds 99.33%, 1 outlier 91.09%"
          - "DeepSeek bimodal: LoRA initialization sensitivity (fail_recall 70.5% vs 100%)"
          - "Even outlier exceeds VOTA 84.45% by 6.64pp"
          - "对比 VOTA gap=14.96pp, no_trace gap=1.77pp"
          - "Qwen seed robustness: 3 seeds 99.83% ± 0.00, irreducible samples (id=901,905)"
        supporting_experiments:
          - "vota_exception_only_seed42_v2: 99.83%"
          - "deepseek_exception_only_seed42: 99.33% (final) / 99.83% (best)"
          - "deepseek_vota_seed42: 84.45%"
          - "deepseek_no_trace_seed42: 73.36%"
          - "exception_only_seed123: 99.83%"
          - "exception_only_seed456: 99.83%"
        figures: [fig_3]
        tables: [tab_2]

      - name: "4.3 Two-Tier Diagnostic Hierarchy"
        status: ready
        claim: 3
        key_points:
          - "Tier 1: exception 99.83%, ae_only 99.92% (p=0.80, 统计等价)"
          - "Tier 2: loop_only 85.6% ≈ label_only_loss 86.2%"
          - "Combining Tier 1+2 (VOTA 99.41%) < Tier 1 alone (exception 99.83%): noise from composition"
          - "vota_no_ae 99.41%: ae 移除不影响 VOTA, 冗余确认"
        supporting_experiments:
          - "vota_ae_only_seed42: 99.92%"
          - "vota_loop_only_seed42: 85.6%"
          - "vota_no_ae_seed42: 99.41%"
        figures: [fig_4]
        tables: [tab_1]

      - name: "4.4 Calibration Analysis"
        status: ready
        key_points:
          - "exception_only ECE=0.003, Brier=0.001 (near-perfect calibration)"
          - "no_trace ECE=0.171, Brier=0.197 (~63x / ~150x gap)"
          - "Tier 1 signals 不仅 accuracy 高，calibration 也近完美"
          - "no_trace 对错误预测过度自信"
        supporting_experiments:
          - "calibration data for all Qwen conditions"
        figures: [fig_5]
        tables: [tab_3]

    pending_data:
      - item: "DeepSeek full_trace v3"
        impact: "补全 cross-model comparison table 第 4 行; 非 blocking"
        fallback: "报告 N/A, Limitations 中说明 chat template bug 根因"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Section 5: Discussion (~1.0 page)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  - section: "5. Discussion"
    status: write_now  # 大部分可写，D2 假说措辞需谨慎
    estimated_length: "1.0 page"
    subsections:
      - name: "5.1 Why Exception Signal Transfers"
        content: "structural simplicity → model-agnostic; 不需要 trace reasoning capability"
        key_points:
          - "Exception 是 binary fault indicator, 结构固定 [ERROR] type: ... message: ..."
          - "VOTA 依赖 trace reasoning, 受限于 pretraining-derived inductive bias"
          - "Design principle: 匹配 deployment model 能力下界"
      - name: "5.2 eval_loss vs Verdict Accuracy Decoupling"
        content: "Token-level loss 与 binary accuracy 方向相反; checkpoint selection 启示"
        key_points:
          - "DeepSeek VOTA: eval_loss +65% 但 accuracy +6.3pp"
          - "推荐 verdict-specific metric 做 checkpoint selection"
      - name: "5.3 CRUXEval Reasoning Gap Hypothesis"
        content: "VOTA gap ∝ CRUXEval execution reasoning gap — 标注为 hypothesis"
        key_points:
          - "Qwen CRUXEval-I 56.5% vs DeepSeek 39.0% (Δ=17.5pp)"
          - "VOTA gap 14.96pp 数值吻合"
          - "明确标注 N=2, 列出 alternatives (tokenizer, pretraining scale 2.75x, chat template)"
      - name: "5.4 Irreducible Samples"
        content: "3 seeds 2/1190 相同 errors → 数据集理论上限"
        key_points:
          - "id=901,905 均为 check_dict_case, pass→fail false negatives"
          - "可能是 labeling noise 或 edge-case 行为"
    writing_notes: "5.3 必须用 hedged language (we hypothesize, suggestive, N=2)"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Section 6: Limitations (~0.4 page)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  - section: "6. Limitations"
    status: write_now
    estimated_length: "0.4 page"
    key_points:
      - "单数据集 (CRUXEval): 需更多 benchmark 验证 generalization"
      - "双模型 (Qwen + DeepSeek): 架构差异充分但 N=2"
      - "单任务 (verdict prediction): exception signal 在 generation/repair 上效果未知"
      - "DeepSeek full_trace collapsed (如未修复则此处披露)"
      - "Calibration 仅 Qwen 1 seed (但 accuracy 3-seed variance=0 支持稳定性)"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Section 7: Conclusion (~0.4 page)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  - section: "7. Conclusion"
    status: wait  # 等 Results 定稿后写
    estimated_length: "0.4 page"
    key_points:
      - "Exception-based fault detection 是 verdict prediction 的 universal mechanism"
      - "Information density 而非 gradient dilution 驱动 trace compression 价值"
      - "Design principle: extract highest-specificity diagnostic signal, discard the rest"
      - "Future work: 多 benchmark, 更多模型, generation tasks"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Appendix (unlimited)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  - section: "Appendix"
    status: partial
    subsections:
      - name: "A. Training Details"
        content: "LoRA config, hyperparameters, hardware, training time per condition"
      - name: "B. VOTA Trace Examples"
        content: "完整示例: full trace vs VOTA vs exception_only (pass case + fail case)"
      - name: "C. Full Experimental Results"
        content: "所有 conditions × models × seeds 的完整表格"
      - name: "D. Irreducible Sample Analysis"
